MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The End of Heartache and Follow the Reaper feel like natural next choices because they combine heaviness with melody, which connects with my repeated listening to In Flames and Soilwork.",
    "Ascendancy and The War Within fit my interest in energetic, riff-driven music; they connect with the intensity I enjoyed in Advance And Vanquish while keeping the melodic appeal I want today."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Pass the Flask feels less suited to my current mood because its raw hardcore emphasis is less appealing to me than heavy music with memorable melodies.",
    "I skipped Satelite because I could not confidently identify the release, and BLEEDING, THE UNCENSORED did not give me enough confidence about melodic hooks; those skips reflect uncertainty as well as preference.",
    "Sevendust, DevilDriver, and A Crow Left of the Murder connect with parts of my taste, but I would leave them for another time because I am more interested in melodic metal right now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Heaviness alone seems to count too much: enjoying aggressive music does not mean I want every kind of harsh or intense release.",
    "My broader rock listening seems to carry too much weight for today's choices; something can fit my general taste without being what I want next."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated In Flames albums and Figure Number Five suggest that the combination of heavy riffs and melody matters more to me than aggression by itself.",
    "I distinguish between music I might enjoy eventually and music I would choose now; today, melodic hooks make the difference."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my interest in heavy music but sometimes missed that melody is what makes a heavy release appealing to me right now."
}
